title: IPO bid response (BSE iBBS) - PROVISIONAL layout
when: After each upload; bid inquiry during and after the issue
purpose: The result of each bid uploaded to iBBS: accepted or rejected with the reason, the application number, the depository validation and the UPI mandate status. PROVISIONAL: correct the columns from BSE notice 20230110-44 Annexure A before relying on it.

columns.name: referenceNumber
columns.note: the member's reference: Ledgerline's bid number

columns.name: upiStatus
columns.note: sponsor bank pay status (10, 11, 12, 13, 21, 22, 31, 100, 110) or its words

linked: Updates IPO bids: exchange status, application number, UPI mandate, depository check, unblocking
source: PROVISIONAL. Official layout: BSE notice 20230110-44 of 10 Jan 2023, Annexure A.xls (standardised across exchanges with ISO tags), not publicly retrievable. Mirrors Ledgerline's provisional NSE response layout until it is in hand.
